about_the_game: This Game Step into the cockpit of a high-synchronization combat mecha in this 2D vertical-scrolling sci-fi shooter, where high-speed action meets provocative resonance. You play as a lone pilot fighting through enemy-controlled airspace dominated by powerful female Valkyries. As you defeat these bosses and progress through the story, you'll unlock deep narrative chapters where your enemies are slowly converted into fully synchronized co-pilots—each bringing their own personality, backstory, and combat abilities.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains sexually explicit scenes involving suggestive dialogue, partial nudity, and simulated intimacy between fictional characters. All depicted characters are over 18 years of age.
The game includes themes of neural synchronization, submission, and emotional transformation presented in a science fiction context. While there are scenes of power imbalance and psychological manipulation, all narrative content is fictional and stylized.
There is no depiction of real-world sexual assault, drug abuse, or self-harm.
